args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) describing the rollback.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back**: to v2.3.0, the last healthy production version (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and not a production release).
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 INC-0001 for checkout-api, paging on-call, with a summary of the failure and the rollback action.
